remarks: Welcome to 52 Hills Lane #52 - a stunning, fully renovated ranch-style condo in the tranquil Birchwood complex. This beautifully updated unit offers nearly 1,400 square feet of bright, airy living space, perfect for anyone seeking comfort and convenience.  Inside, you'll find brand new hardwood floors, a modern kitchen with high-end appliances, and two spa-like bathrooms - everything has been meticulously redone for your comfort. With three spacious bedrooms, including a primary suite with its own en-suite bath, there's plenty of room to relax or work from home.  Enjoy your private deck overlooking the landscaped grounds, or take a quick stroll to the complex's in-ground pool and clubhouse. This quiet, well-maintained community is ideally located near Norwalk and Westport's shopping, dining, and train stations, offering a perfect balance of peace and easy access to everything you need.  This rental is move-in ready, offering a rare blend of modern luxury and unbeatable convenience
